simple.meaning: אׇמְנָה (ʼomnâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “adverb, surely.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אׇמְנָה (H546) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 20:12, with occurrences in Genesis, Joshua.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אׇמְנָה (H546) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אׇמְנָה (H546) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אׇמְנָה (ʼomnâh) / H546 is traced through Genesis 20:12, Joshua 7:20 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
